newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Argentina's YPF and Astra make offer for Mexpetrol.
newsitem.headline: Argentina's YPF and Astra make offer for Mexpetrol.

text.p: Argentine oil companies YPF SA and Astra SA said Friday they jointly made an offer to raise their stake in Mexpetrol Argentina SA.

YPF said this would raise the ownership in Mexpetrol to 67 percent from 50 percent. Astra said in a statement to the Buenos Aires Stock Exchange that Mexpetrol had accepted the offer but the deal was not yet closed.
Mexpetrol Argentina is the operator of the UTE El Porton-Buta oil field which has daily production of 24,500 barrels.
Astra said this purchase would increase its oil production by 11 percent and its reserve levels by 10 percent.
Mexpetrol is owned by Petroleos Mexicanos (Pemex) which has a 25 percent stake, and five private Mexican companies including ICA EPN, Bufete Industrial, Protexa and Empresas Lanzagorta.
